description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ka-Zar of the Savage Land, adding {C}{C}.
When Ka-Zar of the Savage Land dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ka-Zar of the Savage Land from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ka-Zar of the Savage Land enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
